body: Diwali bonus decided: one month's basic pay for everyone who joined before 1 April, paid with the December salary.
The office will be closed on 25 December. 24 December is a half day, closing at 1 pm.
Kaveri Textiles sent the artwork. Quoted Q-121: ₹54,000 plus GST for 1,200 printed mailers, valid 10 days, standard terms.
Lotus Pharma wants 3,000 shipper cartons a month from January. They asked for a sample by 5 December.
I heard Lotus Pharma is also talking to our competitor in Bhiwandi.
Harbor Retail says INV-2211 (₹48,500) will be paid on 4 December by cheque.
Correction: Harbor Retail will pay INV-2211 by NEFT, not cheque. Same date, 4 December.
Lotus Pharma sample pickup booked with Patel Transport for Wednesday 3 December, afternoon.
Patel Transport is raising rates by 8% from 1 January. Their email came in this morning.
Everyone already knows the GST filing moves to the 15th from next month.
